hook: *50,908* voter-deletion forms filed in Telangana after the SIR deadline
hook_b: Is your name still on the Telangana voter list?
tldr: Telangana Today reports 50,908 Form 7 (deletion) applications filed Oct 8–31, after the SIR claims and objections deadline. Officials attribute the figures to a data glitch; the high number of approvals has raised questions about the process.

beats.what: 50,908 Form 7 voter-deletion applications recorded after the SIR deadline
beats.why: SIR = Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls; Form 7 seeks deletion of a name
beats.care: A deletion can remove a voter from the roll; how many were approved and why is not detailed yet

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per Telangana Today: 50,908 Form 7 applications seeking voter deletions were recorded between October 8 and 31, after the SIR claims and objections deadline. Officials attributed the figures to a data glitch. The report says the high number of approvals has raised questions about the process. District-wise numbers, the exact approval count and any review step are not in the report yet.

cards.q: Late voter-deletion forms: what do you want from officials?

insight: Form 7 is the form used to ask for a name to be deleted from the voter roll, and Telangana logged 50,908 of them between October 8 and 31, after claims and objections had closed.

learn.t: Form 6 adds a voter, Form 7 objects to or seeks deletion of a name, Form 8 corrects details.

watch: Whether the election office publishes district-wise deletion and approval figures.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana SIR: Over 50,000 Form 7 applications filed after deadline
